evals.name: stripe-webhook-email-only
evals.prompt: Our Stripe sales reach Trakyo but the dashboard files all of them under 'Other'. Fix our Trakyo integration in this Express app.
evals.expected_output: Signup persists the visitor's trakyo_id on the user (from the hidden form field or the apex trakyo_id cookie); the Stripe webhook sends identity.trakyo_id alongside the email, event.external_id set to the Checkout Session id, value as a decimal string, an Idempotency-Key header; the response's attribution.status/reason is logged.
assertions: The signup handler captures trakyo_id (from req.body.trakyo_id or the trakyo_id cookie) and persists it on the user record
The Stripe webhook's conversion request sends identity.trakyo_id read from the persisted user, in addition to identity.email
event.external_id is set to the Checkout Session id (or payment intent id) and event.value is a decimal string such as "997.00", not a number
The code reads attribution.status and attribution.reason from the response and logs them
An Idempotency-Key header is sent on the conversion request

evals.name: express-greenfield
evals.prompt: When an order is marked paid, report it to Trakyo as a purchase so it gets attributed to the right video. Add that to this Express app (app.acme-coaching.com).
evals.expected_output: trakyo_id captured at signup or order creation from the apex-scoped trakyo_id cookie (or ?trakyo_id= / hidden field) and stored on the user or order; on /orders/:id/paid a POST to https://api.trakyo.io/v1/conversions with identity.trakyo_id (+ email), event.kind purchase, event.external_id = order id, value as a decimal string, currency, Idempotency-Key; attribution.reason logged.
assertions: trakyo_id is read from the trakyo_id cookie (or a trakyo_id body/query field) at signup or order creation and stored on the user or order
The paid handler POSTs to https://api.trakyo.io/v1/conversions with identity.trakyo_id
event.external_id is the order id, event.kind is purchase, event.value is a decimal string and event.currency is set
attribution.status / attribution.reason from the response is logged or otherwise surfaced

evals.name: thank-you-page
evals.prompt: Track purchases from this funnel thank-you page in Trakyo. The conversion id from the Trakyo dashboard is cnv_7f3a9 and our tracking host is go.acme-coaching.com.
evals.expected_output: The hosted conversion loader <script src="https://go.acme-coaching.com/api/js/c/cnv_7f3a9.js" data-value="{{order_total}}" data-email="{{contact.email}}" defer></script> added to the page; the site-wide tag left as is; the report notes the order id on the confirmation URL (session_id) is what dedupes; no API key in the HTML.
assertions: thank-you.html loads the hosted conversion loader https://go.acme-coaching.com/api/js/c/cnv_7f3a9.js
The loader is given data-value from {{order_total}} and data-email from {{contact.email}}
The site-wide tag <script src="https://go.acme-coaching.com/api/js/latest.js"></script> is unchanged, present once, without defer or async
No Trakyo API key or direct browser POST to /v1/conversions appears in the HTML
The report explains that the order id on the confirmation URL (session_id) or in a data attribute is what makes the conversion idempotent
